channel.title: Soheil Mohajer — Blog
channel.description: Research notes and write-ups on Android, AI agents, automation and game logic.

item.title: Node.js Explained: JavaScript's Escape From the Browser
item.description: What Node.js actually is (a runtime, not a language), how the event loop serves thousands of users with one thread, where it beats PHP, Python and Java — and where it loses. With a practical cheat sheet.

item.title: Linux Explained: What It Is, Why People Love It, and Where It Loses
item.description: What Linux actually is (kernel vs distro), how it differs from Windows and macOS, the honest pros and cons, and why it quietly runs most of the internet, all supercomputers and your phone.

item.title: JavaScript Explained: The Language That Quietly Runs the World
item.description: What JavaScript actually is, why it was built in 10 days, where it runs (way beyond the browser), the honest strengths and weaknesses, and why it has been the most-used language on Earth for a decade.

item.title: Git Explained: Version Control, GitHub and GitLab Without the Confusion
item.description: What Git actually is and why it must be installed on your system first, how GitHub and GitLab differ (and why both use the same commands), plus the core workflow and a cheat sheet.

item.title: Docker for Developers: From Kernel to Production
item.description: Why I learned Docker, what containers actually are (in plain words), and a production-grade reference: images and layer caching, Compose v2, networking, and the security traps nobody warns you about.

item.title: Database Systems: How Information Is Organized, Stored and Protected
item.description: Relational and NoSQL models, the anatomy of a DBMS, SQL by example, indexes, transactions and ACID - an introductory map of how modern databases actually work.

item.title: Vue.js: History, Features and Advantages
item.description: A tour of the progressive JavaScript framework: Evan You's original idea, reactivity, single-file components, directives, the Vite ecosystem, and an honest comparison with React and Angular.

item.title: The History of the CPU: From a Calculator Chip to Billions of Transistors
item.description: Six eras of CPU history - the 1971 Intel 4004, the x86 standard, the Pentium years, the GHz race that hit a wall of heat, the multi-core turn, and the modern ARM era.

item.title: Building a Resilient Adhan Scheduler on Android
item.description: AlarmManager lessons from shipping Gah-e Saba: exact alarms, doze mode, OEM battery killers, boot receivers — and how to make scheduling code you cannot fully control testable.

item.title: RTL Survival Guide: Fixing Bidirectional Text in AI Chat UIs
item.description: Why mixing Persian and English breaks in ChatGPT-style UIs, how first-strong detection fails on streamed responses, and the MutationObserver approach shipped in ParsiChat Fixer.

item.title: n8n vs Code-First Agents: Where Low-Code Actually Wins
item.description: After shipping both, an honest comparison of iteration speed, debugging, versioning and cost — and the hybrid architecture I now default to.
